behaviourTrace.comparison: identical JSON of ordered citizen view objects including all public fields, display positions, contact targets, workstation palms, and matching canonical authoritative states before and after presentation and the next simulation tick

poseTrace.method: Babylon.js 9.31.0 NullEngine, 10 shipped male/female source-walk GLB actors, fixed 38 update and render calls, dt .033 and simulation speed 4. 32 frames after warmup counted. Hash covers float32 world matrices of both arms and legs, paws/feet, spine and equipped tool; test cycles 10 tasks, then roof and bench, ladder, freight walk, pause. Profiling counter counts recursive forced calls of TransformNode.computeWorldMatrix(true) within actor update and scene render. Host CPU totals are diagnostic only.

homeLookupMicrobenchmark.scenario: production stress seed 137, mixed homes, 500 residents, 250 buildings, simulation rate 4×
homeLookupMicrobenchmark.type: CPU microbenchmark of homeVisits alone, not measured FPS; mocked catalogue and active platform lookups
homeLookupMicrobenchmark.clock: 180 deterministic simulation frames, each advanced by 1/24 wall-seconds at 4×, nine presentation calls at each state

pausedWebGLFrames.method: Same seed, mixed housing, paused production renderer. Compare lossless canvas PNG bytes. Count WebGL triangles and draws including instances and shadow passes at the same simulation time.
